recursiveemergence.name: Recursive Emergence
recursiveemergence.description: Fractals, cellular automata, and emergent complexity
recursiveemergence.qfep_connection: Fractals and cellular automata â€” complexity from simplicity. Recursive rules generate infinite E(S) from finite F-description. The edge of chaos where simple rules produce unbounded complexity.

artifact_groups.rationale: Time collapsed into space: 1D automata scroll spatially, grabbable rules let players feel the state transition, evolutionary algorithms mutate rulesets, mirror texture wraps output onto 3D form.
Grid life: 2D automata produce gliders, blinkers, and still-lifes from birth/death rules. Lattice gas bridges to fluid dynamics — same grid logic, different interpretation.
Same rules, new dimension: 3D automata and stacked generations show how depth multiplies complexity. Forms emerge that the flat law never predicted.
Two rules, radically different outcomes: Rule 30 generates chaos, Rule 110 proves Turing completeness. The gap between noise and computation is eight bits.
Discrete particles with trivial collision rules converging into Navier-Stokes: fluid dynamics emerging from neighbor counting on a lattice.
Simple addition cascading into the golden ratio: spirals governing sunflowers, shells, and galaxies. Recursion as nature's accumulator.
Recursive tree visualizes call stacks: tail recursion flattens them, memoization caches results, collapsing exponential branching into linear traversal.
Finite contractions converging on attractors: 3D Koch curve shows how a handful of affine matrices encode ferns, forests, and self-similar geometry.
Replace middle thirds forever: a continuous curve with no tangent anywhere. Infinite perimeter, finite area — six characters of rule producing infinite detail.
z → z² + c: escape vs boundedness tested at every point. The boundary between them is where miniature copies of the whole set nest at every scale.
Fix the constant, vary the start: each Julia set indexes unique dynamical behavior. Sierpinski pyramid sits centered as recursion made solid — the sequence's geometric capstone.
